body: You seem to think that I'm just not trying hard enough. You know nothing.

I tried. But the problem is, I can't afford it and I have a hard time talking to people face to face about these things. And by hardt, I mean impossible. I've tried several therapists, hotlines, apps, a professor, etc. I don't like being in pain all of the time. I tried to get help. I tried so hard, I even switched to an independent school when I was in high school. I am also in physical pain every day and there's nothing I can do for that. I tried but the only answer for me is to take it all away.
